prompt: Write 10 distinct lessons the pii-chat agent (card support: identity checks, lost and stolen cards, replacements) at Larkmere Mutual learned across many cases about: going paperless. Each is a working pattern or tip for the next case, not about any one member, one or two sentences, in the agent's voice ("When…, …"). Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 0)
response: {"items":[{"type":"observation","content":"When a member says they want to go paperless, check whether they mean statements, letters, card statements, or all account post, because the right setting can differ by product."},{"type":"fact","content":"When the member has passed identity checks, it is usually quickest to confirm their contact details before switching them to paperless, so the notices go to the right email or mobile number."},{"type":"preference","content":"When a member is unsure about paperless, I explain the benefits in plain terms: faster delivery, less post to keep, and fewer delays if they move home."},{"type":"observation","content":"When a member has had a replacement card, I make sure they know paperless does not change the delivery of the physical card or any security messages about it."},{"type":"fact","content":"When a member asks to stop paper statements, I should check whether any legal or product-specific letters still need to be sent by post."},{"type":"preference","content":"When a member is nervous about missing important mail, I reassure them that they can usually change back later if they prefer paper again."},{"type":"observation","content":"When email addresses bounce or look out of date, I treat paperless enrolment as incomplete until the contact details are updated and confirmed."},{"type":"fact","content":"When a member uses online banking regularly, paperless sign-up tends to be smoother because they are more familiar with digital messages and document access."},{"type":"preference","content":"When a member asks for paperless because they are going away or moving house, I suggest making the change early so they do not lose time waiting for post."},{"type":"observation","content":"When I have completed a paperless switch, I finish by telling the member where to look for future messages and to watch for spam or junk folders if email is the chosen channel."}]}
